{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of War''' was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]]. It was in charge of all [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] forces, and was responsible for turning general directives into achievable strategy. Most of the day to day running of the Ministry was left to the [[Chief of Staff (Alliance Military)|Chiefs of Staff]], leaving the [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Minister]] free to deal with grand strategy.
